output.stem:
협회적하약관(Institute Cargo Clause, 2009) ICC(A)의 제10조 ‘항해의 변경(Change of Voyage)’에 관한 설명으로 옳지 않은 것은?

Where, after attachment of this insurance, the destination is changed ①by the Assured, this must be notified promptly to ②Insurers for rates and terms to be agreed. Should a loss occur prior to such agreement being obtained cover may be provided but only if cover would have been available ③at a reasonable commercial market rate on reasonable market terms.

Where the subject-matter insured commences the transit contemplated by this insurance, but, ④without the knowledge of the Assurer or their employees the ship sails for another destination, this insurance ⑤will nevertheless be deemed to have attached at commencement of such transit.
choices: Insurers for rates and terms to be agreed
at a reasonable commercial market rate on reasonable market terms
without the knowledge of the Assurer or their employees
output.notes: 그림이 여러 조각으로 어긋나 있고 오른쪽이 잘려 있어, 흩어진 조각(발문 뒷부분, 상자 줄 끝, 보기 끝부분)을 이어 붙여 복원함. 중간에 섞여 있는 다른 문항(CISG 제12조) 조각은 제외함. 발문의 'Clause'는 그림 조각 'Claus'+'se'를 따른 것이며 원문은 'Clauses'일 수 있음. 밑줄 범위는 보이는 부분 기준.
